selection_rule: Take ALL metadata-pure TARGET_WINDOW_CONTAMINATION cases after excluding every other reported content-cause category. Sort by numeric FC ID. No pixel-success selection, truncation or reserve cohort.
next_method: Use the unchanged verified card257 source. Begin with each proposed wider native rectangle (union of target/adjacent WHOLE windows and existing context windows plus 24 native pixels); include the actual neighboring construction even if that requires widening again.

Trace competing continuous source paths through neighboring windows. Record new-layer target body locators and separately located competing fragments in native coordinates; preserve immutable base IDs/bboxes.

For each competing fragment state: demonstrated continuity into target; demonstrated continuity into named neighboring physical body; separately bounded but owner still unresolved; or unresolved contact/occlusion. Mere proximity, window inclusion, or a pale gap cannot assign owner.
Render target-plus-neighbor source context with native locators for graphical review. Retain untreated originals and crop/transpose verification; do not erase/threshold background or neighbor traces.

Inventory every target closure/opening, bar, branch, terminal and detached mark after ownership review. Any newly observed independent blocker keeps exclusion and is recorded; ownership resolution alone does not guarantee eligibility.

Return all 15 results, including failures. Eligibility may change only after actual graphical evidence supports the full feature/ownership decision; metadata relabeling or UNKNOWN count changes do not count as graphical resolution.
Preserve semantic roles/letters UNKNOWN and do not form repeat classes in this ownership stage.
